<script>
	document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', function () {
		document.body.classList.add("gdpr-banner-visbile");
		
	})
	var isMobile = /Android|webOS|iPhone|iPad|iPod|BlackBerry|IEMobile|Opera Mini/i.test(window.navigator.userAgent);
	var event =(isMobile)?'touchend': 'click';
	document.addEventListener(event, function (event) {
	    if (event.target.id == "gdprBanner" || event.target.parentElement.id == "gdprBanner" || event.target.id == "privacyPolicy")
				return;
			else
				onCloseIcon();
		})

	function onCloseIcon() {
		window.RDL.createCookie('gbnr', true, 365*5);
		var body = document.body;
		if (body.classList.value.indexOf("gdpr-banner-visbile") > -1)
			body.classList.remove('gdpr-banner-visbile');
	}

</script>

            }
        }
    </script>
